about_the_game:
100 HOLE-IN-ONES. ZERO MERCY.

Drive You Crazy Golf is a brutal mini-golf challenge for 1-4 players. Have as many tries as you need — but every hole MUST be beaten in a single, perfect shot.




TWO WAYS TO SUFFER (AND LAUGH):

🎯 Classic Mode – Conquer 100 hand-crafted holes. Take infinite swings, but only hole-in-ones let you move forward.

🔁 Punishment Mode – Miss your hole-in-one and you’re sent back to the previous hole.

💡 Both modes are fully playable solo or in 1–4 player co-op.




WHY YOU’LL LOVE (AND HATE) IT:

Each of the 100 holes is packed with shifting platforms, spinning traps, lava hazards and pure geometry cruelty.

Timing, power, and precision all matter — but nothing feels better than finally sinking that perfect shot.

Punishment Mode turns up the chaos even more: if your friend misses, you all go back. It’s hilarious, painful and guaranteed to destroy friendships.




FEATURES

⛳ 100 hand-crafted holes.

🔥 Dynamic hazards — lava balls, fans, spinning traps, collapsing floors and more.

💥 Physics-based gameplay that’s equal parts skill and chaos.

👥 Local and online play for up to 4 players.

🧠 Two rage-inducing game modes designed for pain and laughter.




FROM THE SOLO DEV (NESSIE)

I’m a solo developer from the UK who grew up loving chaotic mini-golf videos like Vanoss Crew’s “Hole-in-One Challenges.”

I wanted to turn that concept into an actual game - then make it even more punishing with a mode that sends you back when your friend misses.

Thanks for checking out Drive You Crazy Golf - your support means the world. 💚

Golf through the tears together!
